caption: The drawing features a single object, a candle holder with a candle. The candle holder consists of a round, wide, flat base colored in shades of yellow and gold, giving it a metallic appearance. The base leads to a vertical cylindrical stem that is similarly colored in shades of yellow and gold, detailed with a few horizontal ridges for texture. At the top of the stem, there is a flat, circular platform that supports a white or greyish cylindrical candle. Surrounding the candle is a partially open round shield or guard, depicted in shades of grey, which curves over and partially encloses the candle on three sides while being open at the top and front. The drawing is set against a plain, cream-colored background with a thin rectangular frame. The signature "P. Johnson" is located in the lower right corner inside the frame.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
